business_summary: Hancock Whitney Corporation operates as the financial holding company for Hancock Whitney Bank that provides traditional and online banking services to commercial, small business, and retail customers in the United States. The company offers various transaction and savings deposit products, such as brokered deposits, time deposits, and money market accounts; treasury management services; secured and unsecured loan products, including revolving credit facilities; letters of credit and similar financial guarantees; trust and investment management services to retirement plans, corporations, and individuals; and investment advisory and brokerage products. It also provides commercial and industrial loans, such as commercial non-real estate and real estate loans; construction and land development loans; residential mortgages; and consumer loans comprising second lien mortgage home loans, home equity lines of credit, and nonresidential consumer purpose loans, automobiles, recreational vehicles and boats, other personal purposes, deposit account secured loans, and small portfolio of credit card receivables. In addition, the company offers commercial finance products to middle market and corporate clients comprising leases and related structures; invests in new market tax credit activities and holds certain foreclosed assets; fixed annuity and life insurance products, investment management and advisory, and other services; and underwrites transactions primarily for banking clients, as well as debt and mortgage-related securities. The company was founded in 1899 and is headquartered in Gulfport, Mississippi.
business_summary_ko: Hancock Whitney Corporation은 미국의 상업, 중소기업 및 소매 고객에게 기존 및 온라인 뱅킹 서비스를 제공하는 Hancock Whitney Bank의 금융 지주 회사로 운영됩니다. 회사는 중개예금, 정기예금, 머니마켓 계좌 등 다양한 거래 및 저축예금 상품을 제공합니다. 재무 관리 서비스; 회전 신용 시설을 포함한 담보 및 무담보 대출 상품; 신용장 및 유사한 금융 보증; 퇴직 계획, 기업 및 개인을 위한 신탁 및 투자 관리 서비스; 및 투자 자문 및 중개 상품. 또한 상업용 비부동산 및 부동산 대출과 같은 상업 및 산업 대출도 제공합니다. 건설 및 토지 개발 대출; 주거용 모기지; 2차 담보 모기지 주택 대출, 주택 담보 신용 한도, 비거주 소비자 목적 대출, 자동차, 레저용 차량 및 보트, 기타 개인 목적, 예금 계좌 담보 대출, 소규모 신용카드 미수금 포트폴리오로 구성된 소비자 대출. 또한 회사는 중간 시장 및 공동 고객에게 상업 금융 상품을 제공합니다.
